hdr_accumulation.scope:
Bound native HDR accumulation using saved, unexposed per-light RGB lobes.

This is a Mesh HDR accumulation check conditioned on independently rendered
single-light GPU debug lobes, not a whole-image BRDF oracle. It covers the
non-dual-normal front/back/two graphs only, not Adapter or dual-normal HDR.
Each float32 radiance is bracketed by adjacent representable half values
to cover the source-format conversion; each subsequent half-target addition is
bracketed again. Bounds therefore cover retained float32 or half source precision
without selecting a device-specific blend rounding formula. They are fixed by
the target format and never fitted to measured errors. The strict Capture gate
remains bitwise and separate. Missing-light/transmission mutants must be rejected.

limitations: Skin arithmetic is conditioned on independent GPU source sampling at CPU-computed UVs; ideal CPU filtering failure remains recorded.
Native model integration covers unshadowed Directional and sampled BRDF values; HDR accumulation is format-bounded, not bitwise or a full-image BRDF oracle.
Ordinary per-light deferred rendering is not Clustered. Native shadows/GI/sky/exposure, Clustered, SSR, TSR, Web and final image equivalence remain incomplete.
External Falcor shader/import baseline remains external; this CAS is evidence, not a self-contained executable environment.
Execution-bound source/runtime records and archive-time extra snapshots have distinct categories. Failed sampling diagnostics have their originally recorded scope only.
